== Notes ==
* Uses [[Point blank area of effect]] skills so spread party members before dialogue ends to avoid multiple party members being hit.
* Turns hostile immediately after dialogue concludes.
* Must be defeated unlike other Am Fah who join as ally.
* His death is permanent as he does not self-resurrect.

==Dialogue==
''"The Ministry of Purity will not destroy us. The Am Fah have been around for hundreds of years; its not an organization that will fall so easily."''
